diagnosis: The in-app notification update route executes a direct SQL update via node:sqlite using notificationId without constraining the WHERE clause to req.user.id. An authenticated user can alter the read or dismissed state of critical security alerts, password change confirmations, and fraud detection notices belonging to any other user on the platform.
